workflows.name: Keep Home quote-entry fields outside the calculator
workflows.statement: The calculator opened from Home does not display these quote-entry fields again. Home passes their values internally for calculation.

workflows.name: Validate quote entry before opening the calculator
workflows.statement: Validate quote entry before opening the calculator; remain with errors if validation fails.

workflows.name: Carry quote choices into the application
workflows.statement: Apply validates applicable answers and selections, carries quote data including tobacco answers and selected riders into the application, closes the calculator and navigates to Membership.
